name: Largest directories under a path (Linux)
description: Shows the largest first-level directories under a root directory, staying on one filesystem. Aborts after 120 seconds.

params.name: root_dir
params.label: Root directory
params.description: Absolute path whose first-level subdirectories are measured.

output: Sorted size list. Exit 0; exit 2 on an invalid path or number; notes when the scan timed out.
